The previous enrollment and commitment acceptance no longer count. Update the schedule and commitment, then confirm the reschedule to send fresh invitations. Employees must accept again.
Scheduled participants stay on the roster. Add another employee and use Invite Selected to send their invitation; employees can reject their invitations.
